Meet ColorPops Nailbar

Where nails become works of art

ColorPops Nailbar is a nail salon at 743 W Main St in Lansdale. In its own words: 'Where nails become works of art and colors come alive. Step into here and let your nails truly smile.'

The shop is unmistakable on Main Street: hot-pink trim, a pink door, and a giant polish-bottle sign on the sidewalk. Inside, the pedicure chalkboard runs Basic $20, Classic $25, Deluxe $40, Royal $55.

The sidewalk board prices a classic manicure at $15, gel manicure $30, and powder dip $40. ColorPops is listed on Fresha for booking.
